title: Fixed Bent Boom and Vertical Flight Post Hole Digger
description: One newly authored whole fixed three-point-style post-hole-digger implement in its own parked display pose. A complete continuous high bent boom runs from the open upper attachment eye to a full rear gearbox suspension. A separate broad lower yoke with two long converging members, a full transverse lower beam, two proud lower attachment pins and a middle pivot crossshaft supports the boom. One full closed right-angle gearbox exterior carries a long vertical core and a complete thick two-and-a-quarter-turn tapered helical flight with a blunt broad lower shoe. A long sloping input-driveline enclosure has full flared end covers and a closed terminal, held above the lower frame by its own storage cradle. Two splayed rear parking legs attached to a full gearbox bracket and one front parking leg have three separate finite whole ground soles. The full machine, not an enlarged hand soil-auger or a selected old subassembly, is newly authored; no old grip, auger flight, subsoiler hitch, grain tube, wheel or frame imported. Unlike the hand T-auger it has the entire bent boom, converging lower yoke, right-angle drive and three-foot parked support organization; unlike the inclined transfer auger it has no transport tube, inlet hopper or wheels; unlike the subsoiler it has no three deep shanks, high lateral toolbar or gauge tyres. One whole model zero scenes. Static low-poly exterior only; no boring, rotation, lift motion, shaft telescoping, input drive transmission, gearbox internals, exact three-point or PTO compatibility, cutting performance, support stability, loading, manufacture, engineering or safety capability made or verified. Blunt display tips, no functional sharp edge. Rigging animation physics interaction not made.
